recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, distressed typographic composition featuring a dense stack of bold, sans-serif text blocks in black and white against a vibrant, textured red background. The design uses varying font scales and a 'word cloud' style arrangement that feels heavy, industrial, and cinematic.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale hierarchy between primary title and secondary list items
High-contrast interplay between black, white, and saturated red
Uniform distressed texture applied across all elements
Tight, interlocking vertical stacking of text blocks
coreInvariants: Vibrant orange-red background with subtle grunge noise
Distressed, eroded edges on all characters
Strictly vertical stacking with minimal margins

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary title occupies the top third of the frame at a massive scale, while a dense grid of smaller text blocks fills the remaining two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest white word in the center-top acts as the primary focal point due to its brightness and scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scanning, moving from the largest bold headers to the smaller, interlocking blocks below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space within the text cluster; generous red margins on the left, right, and top edges.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with extreme value contrast in the foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Eroded/distressed texture applied as a mask
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars added as dividers between text sections
Rough, irregular edges to simulate old screen printing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales to create internal contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed, and aggressive feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary condensed structure for the list items.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid vibrant orange-red background with a subtle, dark grunge texture and faint vertical paper-fold lines. Add a very thin border of dark bricks at the very bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in a blocky, interlocking layout. Use black for the top and bottom rows and white for the middle rows. Apply a heavy 'distressed' or 'stamp' texture to the text so the red background peeks through the letters.

verificationChecks: Texture is consistent across all letters
Layout is vertically stacked with minimal gaps
Color palette is limited to red, black, and white

adjustableVariables: Ratio of black to white text blocks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no characters are blurry or illegible due to texture
Check that the red background doesn't overpower the black text
Verify the bottom brick detail is subtle and doesn't distract
Confirm all text is perfectly aligned to a central vertical axis
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a heavy condensed sans-serif font with a high-contrast three-color palette and a uniform 'eroded stamp' texture to create a gritty, cinematic editorial layout.
